subject: Escrow option & temporary PO waiver for StellarTech pilot
messages:

Cc: procurement@stellartech.com
Date: 2027-04-29T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot kickoff and onboarding — request for no-PO path

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at StellarTech is excited to move forward with a 3-week pilot (approx estimated spend $6k-$10k). We can start immediately, but our procurement team typically requires a PO to open a vendor in their system.

Because this is a short, exploratory engagement, I wanted to ask whether Redwood can onboard us on a temporary no-PO basis while we finalize internal paperwork. We've completed your onboarding form and attached it here. We can also share our signed MSA and Certificate of Insurance right away.

If a full waiver isn't possible, would Redwood consider an alternative like:
- prepayment to an escrow/holding account managed by Redwood finance, or
- charge on a corporate card for the pilot period

Either option would let us start sooner and avoid delaying the pilot while our internal PO process (which can take 2–3 weeks) completes.

Attaching: StellarTech_Onboard_Form.pdf

Happy to hop on a quick call to align.

Best,

Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff and onboarding — request for no-PO path

Thanks Ellie — great to see the momentum. I appreciate you sending the completed onboarding form.

Quick answers up front: we can do a short-term exception but procurement and finance need a couple of safeguards before we flip the switch. Options that typically work:

1) Temporary PO waiver (procurement-approved) for a capped amount and fixed duration (e.g., up to $12k for 30 days).
2) Prepayment to a Redwood escrow/prepay account (Finance-managed).
3) Corporate credit card payment for initial invoices (less preferred from accounting side).

Can you confirm you can provide the signed MSA stub and COI? I see you attached the onboarding form — thanks. I’m looping Laura from Procurement and David from Platform Finance to weigh in on the preferred path and the exact gating items we need.

Next steps from my side: I’ll ask Procurement for a conditional waiver and list of required docs (MSA/COI + vendor tax info). If Finance agrees to an escrow route, Priya (finance) will give the wiring/invoice routing steps.

Would love a 20-min call if you’re available this afternoon to finalize — otherwise we’ll handle via email.

Best,
Chloe
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Ellie Zhang <ellie.zhang@stellartech.com>
Cc: david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-29T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Conditional PO-waiver for StellarTech pilot (internal approval)

Chloe / Ellie —

Procurement has reviewed the onboarding form and StellarTech's stated pilot scope. We can approve a temporary PO-waiver under the following conditions:

- Waiver limit: not to exceed $12,000 total spend for the pilot period.
- Duration: 30 calendar days from the first invoice date.
- Required evidence before start: signed MSA (or MSA stub with signature block), Certificate of Insurance (COI), and vendor tax identification (W-9 or equivalent).
- Billing cadence: invoices monthly; Redwood will track cumulative spend and automatically reinstate PO requirement if the threshold is reached.

Alternative accepted: if StellarTech prefers, Finance can take a prepayment into a Redwood-managed escrow account; procurement will still require the same vendor docs but will not require an internal PO while funds are in escrow. The escrow option is preferable for us because it avoids invoice exceptions later.

I will prepare a short waiver memo (procurement_waiver_ST-089.pdf) for internal audit and compliance. Ellie, please upload the MSA and COI to the Drive link Chloe shared and confirm vendor tax docs so we can finalize the waiver.

If anything in the pilot scope changes (duration, expected spend, or billing terms), notify procurement immediately to avoid billing holds.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ellie Zhang <ellie.zhang@stellartech.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Finance notes — escrow wiring and invoice routing for ST-089

All —

Finance can accept a prepayment to our temporary vendor prepay account for this specific pilot. If StellarTech chooses escrow: please follow these steps so we can mark the vendor as active without a PO:

1) StellarTech wires prepayment to: Redwood Treasury — Account (instructions in attached Prepay-Instructions.pdf). Include deal reference ST-2027-PILOT-089 in the wire memo.
2) Once funds land, Finance will create a temporary credit ledger and notify Procurement to issue the 30-day waiver.
3) Invoices should be routed to procure-pay@redwood.com with a copy to finance@redwood.com; include vendor legal name and the deal reference.
4) Accounting code to use for pilot spend: PROD-PILOT-2027.

We will return any unused funds after the pilot or apply them to subsequent committed spend if both parties agree. For card payments, we can accept a corporate card but need a card authorization form and it requires faster reconciliation.

Ellie — please upload the COI and signed MSA to the Drive link and confirm wire timing (or confirm card details). Once we have docs and either wire confirmation or card auth, we’ll mark vendor active and Procurement will publish the waiver memo.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Accounting Manager — Revenue & Cash Ops
Redwood Inference
